Consequently src/cli/commands/graph.ts init/sync/status (new TokensaveCli at lines 112, 203, 286) and src/graph/pipeline-lifecycle.ts (new TokensaveCli at line 114, for the GraphHookHandler sync loop) resolve the backend for the prereq check but then IGNORE it and hardcode a tokensave CLI. So with backend=code-review-graph the CLI init/sync/status shells out to tokensave instead of honoring the resolved backend.

For the CodeReviewGraphBackend stub, backend.cliMap() throws 'code-review-graph adapter not implemented until Sprints 4-6' — that clean NOT_IMPL error is the CORRECT honored behavior for now (better than silently running tokensave or an ENOENT).
